title_sq: Duplex per shitje te Kopshti Botanik
description_sq:
Shitet apartament Duplex te Kopshti Botanik, pallat i ri.
Ndodhet ne katin 3 dhe 4. Eshte totalisht i mobiluar me punime druri origjinale, 2 tualetet te investuara me cilesine me te mire dhe standartet me te larta hidrosanitate incaso.
Elektroshtepiaket incaso te markes Bosch, pianur me induksion, lavastovilie, frigorifer Samsung dopio kanat.
Sistemi i kondisionimit Mitsubishi si dhe panele diellore.
Arredimi me arkitekt dhe punime guri.
Ka nje siperfaqe 110 m2 ne total dhe 94.2 siperfaqe neto.
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni!
title_en: Duplex for sale in the Botanical Garden
description_en: Duplex apartment for sale in the Botanical Garden, new building. It is located on the 3rd and 4th floor. It is fully furnished with original woodwork, 2 invested toilets with the best quality and the highest incaso sanitary standards. Bosch incaso appliances, induction hob, dishwasher, Samsung refrigerator, double jug. Mitsubishi air conditioning system as well as solar panels. Furnishing with architect and stonework. It has a surface of 110 m2 in total and 94.2 net surface. For more information contact us!
